replication.target_description: Study 1B, American sample: simple linear regression of mean perceived face-likeness ratings over 35 images on continuous religiosity. This is not identification of predefined face-like regions or a believer-group comparison as described in the supplied neutral locator.

n.sample_role: American participants included in the simple linear regression after exclusions
n.exclusions: Six of 100 recruited participants excluded using the a-priori criterion. Criterion: extreme slider values (1, 50, 100) on at least 95% of test trials and choosing 6 (do not wish to respond) for importance of religion, as worded in the paper. Three practice trials excluded.
